stories.title: Russian strike on warehouse near Kyiv kills at least 37
stories.summary: Attack on business apparently storing ‘explosive objects’ sparks huge fire, damaging residential buildings At least 37 people have been killed after a Russian drone struck a warehouse near Kyiv’s western suburbs which appears to have been storing “explosive objects”. The attack damaged at least 50 residential buildings, including a care home for elderly and disabled people, and sparked a huge fire and explosions in the Bucha district of the Ukrainian capital. The regional governor, Tymur Tkachenko, said a further 42 people, including four children, had been injured after the Russian drone strike. Continue reading...

stories.title: Zimbabwe minibus carrying church members crashes, killing at least 27
stories.summary: The crash occurred when a truck overtook another vehicle and struck the minibus, police say. The crash happened at about 18:30 GMT on Friday near Chivhu, about 140km (87 miles) south of the capital, Harare, police spokesperson Paul Nyathi said on Saturday. The truck was trying to overtake another vehicle when it crashed with the minibus taxi, which was carrying members of a popular African Christian denomination who were travelling for a conference, he said. State-run broadcaster ZBC News, quoting a provincial government minister, said 23 people died at the scene, while others succumbed to their injuries after being admitted to a local hospital. Footage shared on social media by ZBC showed the mangled minibus charred to a shell, with the truck on the opposite side of the road. The crash occurred in a flat, remote stretch of road, with low vegetation lining the roadside and open terrain beyond. The incident is the latest in a string of deadly crashes on Zimbabwe’s roads, which are riddled with potholes after years of underfunding and neglect. For everyday transport, many Zimbabweans rely on the privately run minibus taxis, known locally as kombi, but they are often criticised for overloading. In April, at least 18 people were killed when a minibus burst into flames on a highway in the south, while earlier that month a woman and her five children died when their vehicle collided with a haulage truck on another highway linking Zimbabwe and South Africa.

stories.title: Eight Russians missing on China-Nepal border — Russian Embassy
stories.summary: The diplomatic mission reported that they had not received any information about their discovery
article_sentences: Eight Russian nationals are listed as missing in the disaster area on the China-Nepal border, the Russian Embassy in China said.
"As of the evening of August 29, eight Russians are listed as missing in the disaster area on the China-Nepal border.
The diplomatic mission has received no information that they have been found," the statement said.

stories.title: Laurie Anderson’s next manuscript to be locked away for 88 years in Future Library
stories.summary: Grammy award-winning American artist selected as 13th person to submit written work to Oslo-based project The next manuscript by the American artist Laurie Anderson will remain unseen for 88 years, as she becomes the 13th figure to contribute to the Future Library project. Anderson joins Margaret Atwood, Han Kang, Ocean Vuong and other prominent authors who have written secret manuscripts, which have been locked away until 2114. Continue reading...
